description: Magyar Közút Nonprofit Zrt.: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Public Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Magyar Közút Nonprofit Zrt.. Coverage: Magyar Közút Nonprofit Zrt.. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Önkormányzati utak adatai - Helyi közutak hossza: Település kategória; Önkormányzati utak adatai- Helyi közutak területe és átlagszélessége; Önkormányzati utak adatai - Helyi közutak hossza: Kiépített-Kiépítetle; Országos közúthálózat információs eredménytáblái. Formats seen: XLS, XLSX, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-kozadatportal.
